We are seeking an operator for a dynamic metalworking company in the Dendermonde region who will be responsible for manufacturing high-quality products such as rebar and spacers. You will work with modern technologies in an innovative and sustainable environment and contribute to the company's success.

 
• 
You have technical insight and, preferably, prior experience as an operator.

 
• 
You will work in a robotized environment, operate machines, and check the quality of the final product.

 
• 
You have a technical background (A2 or equivalent through experience).

 
• 
You can communicate fluently in Dutch or English.

 
• 
You will work in two shifts and are a true team player.

📍 Location: Brussels, Belgium

🏢 On-site: Up to 5 days/week on-site required

🌍 Languages: Fluent Dutch or French (C2) + English (C1)

💰 Rate: 65-70/h
Overview

We are looking for a senior System Engineer with extensive experience in large-scale enterprise environments to manage, maintain, and evolve a complex EndPoint infrastructure supporting more than 100,000 endpoints and 1,000+ applications. You will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and continuous improvement of the EndPoint ecosystem across multiple platforms.
Key responsibilities

• Manage and support desktops, laptops, smartphones, tablets, smartwatches, and industrial devices

• Design, implement, and maintain EndPoint and backend infrastructure solutions

• Perform upgrades, migrations, deployments, and infrastructure enhancements

• Conduct technical feasibility studies and recommend optimal solutions

• Ensure infrastructure stability, security, and compliance.

• Provide 3rd line support and participate in on-call activities when required.

• Act as a technical advisor for business and IT stakeholders.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation and share knowledge across teams

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in System Engineering or EndPoint Infrastructure

• Experience in enterprise environments with:

• 100,000+ endpoints

• 1,000+ software packages

• Experience working within ITIL-driven organizations

• MCSA, MCSE, MCSD or equivalent Microsoft certification

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

On an average day, you'll troubleshoot machine malfunctions, perform preventive maintenance, and collaborate with machine setters and operators to enhance production processes. Your proactive efforts will contribute to improvements in quality, output, and safety.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

• Technical school degree

• Good level of English

• Problem-solving mindset

About the Role
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key Responsibilities
• Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq.
• Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design.
• Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency.
• Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team.
Requirements & Qualifications
• Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects.
• Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts.
• Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory).
• Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects.
• Language Skills:
• Fluent English (written and spoken).
• Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration).
• Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams.

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.

You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC1

• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

We are looking for a Functional IAM Business Analyst to join an Identity Governance (IGA) team at one of our clients in the financial sector. This isn't a generic BA role. You'll work at the heart of access governance, shaping how people get, keep and lose access across the organisation.
Your role

You'll define and improve the processes that govern who gets access to what. That includes access request flows, periodic recertification campaigns and Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes. You'll make sure these controls are robust enough for internal audit and regulators. You'll also follow up on control findings and translate them into concrete process improvements.
Making access simpler

Your "customers" are internal users: a manager reviewing 200 access rights, or an employee requesting the access they need to do their job. Your goal is to make those journeys simpler and less painful, without compromising compliance.

• Several years of experience as a Business Analyst in IAM or IT security

• Experience in banking or insurance is a strong advantage

• Hands-on functional experience with an IGA tool. SailPoint IdentityIQ is a big plus; Saviynt or Oracle Identity Manager are also relevant

• Solid knowledge of access reviews and certifications, RBAC and role models, Segregation of Duties (SOD) and least privilege

• Familiarity with banking regulation and control expectations (DORA, ECB/NBB, internal audit findings)

• At ease working with business stakeholders, audit and compliance teams

• Fluent in French or Dutch, plus English

A hands-on Network Architect role where Juniper and Fortinet meet complex, business-critical infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational technology organisationoperating critical digital infrastructure. As part of the continued development of their infrastructure environment, they are looking for aNetwork Architectto join a highly skilled and collaborative technical team.

 

This is not a purely conceptual architecture role. You will move betweenarchitecture, design, implementation and production support, working with modern networking technologies and having a direct impact on the resilience and evolution of the infrastructure.

 

Your playground? Juniper, Fortinet, BGP, DNS, security and distributed infrastructure.
Network Architect - The Role
• Design and evolvenetwork architecturesacross complex and distributed production environments, from high-level concepts to low-level technical designs.
• Work hands-on withJuniper networking and Fortinet security technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls and network segmentation.
• Contribute toBGP, DNS/DNSSEC, high-availability and distributed infrastructure, with a strong focus on resilience and security.
• Drive improvements aroundautomation, monitoring and observability, using technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Prometheus or Grafana.
• Collaborate withInfrastructure, Security, Architecture and Software Engineeringteams, while challenging and validating technical solutions delivered by external partners.
• Maintainarchitecture documentation, diagrams and technical standards, while supporting troubleshooting, lifecycle management and production environments.
Network Architect - The Profile
• 7+ years of experiencein network, infrastructure or systems engineering, with strong exposure to critical production environments.
• Strong expertise innetworking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching and protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
• Solid hands-on experience withJuniper and Fortinet— this is a key part of the role.
• Good understanding ofLinux, DNS/DNSSEC, firewalls and high-availability/distributed infrastructure.
• Exposure tovirtualisation, containers, private cloud or Infrastructure as Code(VMware, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, etc.) is a strong plus.
• Analytical, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move from architecture and design to implementation and production troubleshooting. Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Wheel Loader Operator Wanted for Recycling Site in Sint-Katelijne-Waver

Operating a forklift is also part of your tasks, as well as carrying out daily inspections and basic maintenance of the machines. You promptly report technical issues and ensure the workplace remains safe and tidy, even in dusty conditions.

Does this hands-on, varied position appeal to you? Apply soon – I am happy to tell you more about this great opportunity.

• Valid wheel loader license (required by Belgian regulations)

• Willingness to operate a forklift (license is a plus)

• Good command of English (spoken and written)

• Able to work independently and reliably
